caption: This shoyu ramen features a golden-brown, glossy broth with floating noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with a subtle speckled pattern, round chashu pork and pale yellow, slightly translucent menma bamboo shoots are served on a dark wooden table with visible grain.

segments_info.text: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle reflections near the bowl's edge.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish meat, white fat, and a slightly glossy surface.
The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, slightly translucent, with a soft texture and faint green specks on their irregular, curled surface.
White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface, subtle speckled pattern, and slightly raised, unadorned rim.
